---

# 🏢 Acme Corp — Pipeline Risk Assessment
**Date:** July 14, 2026 | **Tier:** Strategic | **Industry:** Manufacturing | **CSM:** alex.morgan | **ARR:** $45M

---

## 💼 Open Pipeline

| Opportunity | Stage | Amount | Close Date | Probability | Forecast |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Acme - Support Renewal FY27 | Negotiation/Review | $42,000 | **Aug 15, 2026** | 80% | ✅ Commit |
| Acme - Q3 Platform Expansion | Proposal/Price Quote | $185,000 | **Sep 30, 2026** | 60% | ⚠️ Best Case |
| **Total Open Pipeline** | | **$227,000** | | | |

> **Context:** These deals follow a recently Closed Won $310K Data Warehouse Migration deal (Mar 2026), confirming Acme is an active, expanding customer.

---

## 🎫 Recent Support Tickets

| # | Priority | Status | Subject | Created | Signal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1042 | 🔴 **HIGH** | **OPEN** | Workflow execution failures — retry loop after connector timeout | Jul 13, 2026 | 🚨 Escalated, `engineering-review`, `BUG-4571` |
| 1043 | 🟡 Normal | Pending | SSO group mapping for Acme finance team | Jul 9, 2026 | ⏳ Waiting on customer |
| 1044 | 🟢 Low | Solved ✅ | Enable Workato Insights for sandbox workspace | Jun 24, 2026 | 👍 Positive CSAT: *"Fast turnaround"* |

**Ticket #1042 Detail:** Production workflows began **retry looping** after a connector timeout (>30s) on **July 13 UTC**, affecting Acme's entire workflow batch. It's escalated, linked to a Jira bug, and still open as of today.

---

## 📊 Product Usage Trend (Last 2 Rolling Periods)

| Metric | May 14 – Jun 13 | Jun 14 – Jul 13 | Δ Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly Active Users | 51 | 42 | 🔴 **-18%** |
| Weekly Active Users | 34 | 28 | 🔴 **-18%** |
| Avg Daily Active Users | 15.1 | 12.4 | 🔴 **-18%** |
| Sessions | 2,210 | 1,840 | 🔴 **-17%** |
| Workflow Runs | 21,400 | 18,422 | 🔴 **-14%** |
| Feature Adoption Score | 0.80 | 0.78 | 🟡 **-2.5%** |

> **Last Active:** Jul 12 — usage data doesn't yet reflect the Jul 13 incident.

---

## ⚠️ Risk Summary & Recommended Actions

### 🚨 Risk 1 — Active Production Incident Threatening Both Deals
The HIGH-priority ticket (#1042) is a live production outage that started **yesterday**, just 32 days before the **$42K renewal closes (Aug 15)**. An unresolved incident entering renewal negotiations is a significant churn signal.
- **Action:** Escalate resolution of BUG-4571 immediately. CSM (alex.morgan) should proactively reach out to Acme today with a status update and ETA — don't let them feel abandoned heading into renewal.

### 📉 Risk 2 — Broad Usage Decline Across All Metrics (~18%)
Every engagement metric dropped ~18% period-over-period. This likely predates the July 13 incident, suggesting a **structural engagement drop**, not just an outage effect. This weakens the ROI narrative needed to justify the **$185K expansion**.
- **Action:** CSM should conduct a usage review call to identify if workflows are being deprecated, users churned, or if this is a seasonal/project dip. Tie expansion value prop to current production use cases, not projected ones.

### 📅 Risk 3 — Tight Renewal Timeline with Open Friction
The **$42K renewal (Commit stage)** closes in ~32 days. Two active tickets — one production critical, one SSO/identity friction — create negative sentiment entering the negotiation window.
- **Action:** Resolve both tickets before the renewal conversation. Proactively offer an incident post-mortem to demonstrate reliability. Use the solved Insights provisioning ticket (positive CSAT) as a relationship bridge.

### ✅ Positive Signal — Expansion Intent is Real
The sandbox Insights enablement and SSO integration work signal Acme is **actively expanding their footprint**, not winding down. The $185K expansion is credible if support issues are resolved quickly.

---

**Bottom line:** Acme Corp carries **$227K in live pipeline** but faces a convergence of a critical production incident and a sustained ~18% usage decline right before renewal close. The next 1–2 weeks are pivotal — swift incident resolution and a proactive CSM touchpoint could protect both deals.
